description: Control and contextual follow-ups for the active player: pause, resume, skip, play the next song, append one exact next song, adjust the music level, explain why a song is present, open an explicitly requested documented sample lineage, or return to the story. The result updates the mounted card in place. For an AI-DJ transition to a newly chosen record, pass queueTrack with exact artist and title; OffStereo resolves it and appends it to this same widget so the current song can finish and auto-advance. Keeping the transition in this queue avoids a second make_playable call. Use instruction='Queue this as the next song without interrupting the current song' to queue ahead, or 'Play this next now' to append and immediately advance. A why-this-song question preserves the queue. sessionId identifies the active session, and activeItemId plus positionMs preserve exact continuity when the card supplies them.

acknowledgeDirectiveId.description: Mounted-card acknowledgement for the exact one-shot playback directive it has finished applying. Periodic cursor syncs omit this field.

queueTrack.description: One exact new record to append to the active widget queue. Use this instead of opening another one-song widget when the listener asks the AI DJ to choose what comes next.

reason.description: A concise, factual transition reason for why this record follows the current one.

name: steer_session

outputSchema.description: A PlayableSession: one canonical OffStereo card with its ordered narration-and-song queue and live build/playback status.

id.description: Stable session id, reused for get_session and steer_session.

playbackDirective.description: One-shot transport request the mounted card applies.

status.description: Lifecycle: building, partial, ready, failed, and similar.

title: Steer the listening session
